page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU corresponds to a dedicated physical core, eliminating hyperthreading overhead. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps to support high-throughput network operations. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density make it a specialized resource for memory-intensive workloads, offering a predictable performance profile without resource contention.

The ecs.r7.16xlarge is designed for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity and dedicated compute resources. Appropriate use cases include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise applications, caching layers, and memory-intensive data processing or analytics tasks.
